title: Restormel route step rich metadata
description: Optional JSON blobs stored on route_steps and echoed in resolve stepChain (contract 2026-04-14+). Additional properties are allowed for forward compatibility.

switchCriteria.description: Switch hints; hosts interpret. Optional `advanceOn` lists suggested failure kinds to advance to the next tier.

advanceOn.description: Suggested failure kinds that mean "try next tier" (host interpretation). Echoed on resolve `stepChain` as `advanceOn` when set.

retryOn.description: Suggested failure kinds to retry on same tier before advancing (host interpretation).
